data.description:
### 2. Incident Overview
* **Scenario Type:** Sub-Agent Blocker (epic-588e closure)

#### Expected Behavior
After `ticket edit <child> --parent=null` detaches a child, the parent epic's close-guard should no longer count it as an open child (consistent with `ticket list-descendants`, which immediately excludes it).

#### Actual Behavior
Detached 3274-5ed0-7fef-4a43 from epic 588e (verified: 3274 parent_id=='' and 3274 ABSENT from `ticket list-descendants 588e`). Yet `ticket transition 588e open closed` still failed with "cannot close ... 1 open child ticket(s): 3274-5ed0-7fef-4a43". The close-guard reads a stale child-index/reverse-map that the --parent=null edit does not refresh, while list-descendants uses a live scan. Worked around with --force. Two independent reads (parent_id, list-descendants) confirm the detach; only the close-guard disagreed.
data.title: [ticket-cli]: epic close-guard child-index not refreshed by --parent=null detach -> false 'open child' block
